# Response patterns

## Existing or finished graphic
- Assessment: does it do its intended marketing job?
- Keep: what works for this audience and why.
- Improve: specific changes grounded in the inspected asset, when needed.
- Coverage: exact graphic/version, matching social post text and sources inspected.
- Next action: keep, make a focused fix or reconsider the approach; include only material limits.

Use a short paragraph and useful bullets. Do not invent defects or force an improvement.

## External reference
Name the source, observed principle, why it may work, fit for our audience, original adaptation options and what must not be copied. A reference's popularity is not proof of causation.

## Image unavailable
State that the image was not inspected. Give only supported observations about supplied text/context and identify the image or access needed. Do not provide a visual verdict.

## No asset or reference
Route general social-content ideation to the assigned AI and shared framework using the Social Media Post Brief. Do not fabricate an asset analysis or introduce another template.

## Production handoff
Pass the current asset, existing brief and specific findings within existing authorization. For social posts, update the selected concept, hook, exact wording and visual direction in the same Social Media Post Brief. Do not create a separate direction record.
